scope: Read-only diagnosis of owner-configured repository monitoring and actual installed Work review listing; fixtures remain separate from host observation.
findings: Initial sequential full enrichment delayed gocql import about five minutes and python-driver import about ten minutes; linked-reference backfill then delayed subsequent polls.
The initial shared snapshot measured 33954766 bytes after both imports. The first reduction measured 9043517 bytes; normalized linked check lists still dominated that response.

A first Work open_factory attempt returned Transport closed. After final compaction and Refresh tools, a repeated read-only open_factory opened the actual inbox. The exact host transport failure mechanism is unproven.
changes: Three independent repository workers with four enrichment workers each; per-repository atomic checkpoints and cancellation on enrichment failure.

Reference backfill uses a ten-second scheduled budget, rotates attempted targets and does not replace successful metadata with cancellation errors. Healthy monitored open PRs avoid redundant reference enrichment.
Shared snapshots/listings omit bulk activity, raw checks and own/linked full check lists. Selected-item reads retain full content and the UI uses those full records for existing CI disclosures.
